instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Split a document into its smallest self-contained pieces, a page per call, so every check can name the piece it came from", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:split-a-document-into-pieces and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give one of the person's files by name (as /folder/file.md, read through their files door page by page, so a file of any size up to 4 MB is never sent in one request body), or the text of a short document (Markdown), and optionally its file name and its identity.
4. It reads files only, through the files door (read_file), and writes nothing: the answer holds the pieces, and your AI keeps them in the store it chooses.
